row: My name is Nik Wright and I am a LMT (Licensed Massage Therapist), and I operate a small studio in Southfield Michigan. I specialize in Deep Tissue, Myofascial Release, and Stretch Therapy. I will be using this channel to showcase stretching routines for clients, how to videos, and educational opportunities.
